what_it_does_ko: Groq는 추론 전용 칩 LPU를 만들었고, LPX로 NVIDIA 차세대 GPU와 함께 대규모 추론을 제공한다고 밝힌다. 플랫폼은 전용 베어메탈 인프라(GroqMetal), 그 위의 추론 스택(GroqCore), 엔터프라이즈 거버넌스·감사(GroqAssured) 세 층으로 구성된다. 4개 대륙 13개 데이터센터에서 운영 중이다.

evidence.quote: Groq Closes $350 million Series A, Building the World's Leading AI Inference Cloud
Groq is the premier neocloud for fast inference
Build your perfect stack. GroqMetal provides infrastructure, GroqCore adds inference, and GroqAssured adds enterprise controls.
Now operating 13 data centers across four continents
Dedicated bare-metal infrastructure, tuned for speed and reliability, with full control in your hands.
A tested inference stack that turns dedicated capacity into production-ready performance, no infrastructure expertise required.
Enterprise-grade governance, auditability, and control layered on top, so scale never comes at the cost of trust.
